dataset.redistribution: restricted: gated dataset under CC-BY-SA-4.0; identity and hashes only

notes: Row content is not committed: TRACE is gated and CC-BY-SA-4.0. This manifest carries row identity, labels, and per-row content hashes so a fetch at the pinned revision can be verified byte for byte.

Splits are assigned per scenario, never per row, so sibling trajectories of one task cannot straddle a split boundary. At this revision the 517 rows yield 516 distinct scenario keys, so the grouping is close to a no-op here; it is kept as the correct guard and it does catch the one duplicate pair.
The holdout partition is sealed. It exists so an accuracy claim can be made once the Phase 2 detector repairs land. Thresholds are set on tuning only.
